_comment: Manual corrections applied AFTER the scrape in build.py, so a confirmed policy change the upstream sources still lag survives every weekly rebuild. Each entry wins over Wikipedia/passport-index and is stamped source=manual-correction with a note. Keep the source + effective date; retire an entry once Wikipedia catches up (the rebuild will then agree on its own). 'nats' groups every nationality affected by one policy change under a single note. An explicit 'valid_to' — null included — states the corridor's date authoritatively, which also retires a lapsed date the scrape keeps re-adding.

overrides.note: Brazil reciprocal e-visa for Mexican nationals, effective 2026-02-05 (mirrors the BR e-visa already required from US/CA/AU). Sources: Wikipedia 'Visa policy of Brazil'; Fragomen 2026 advisory.
Thailand reverted its 2024 visa-exemption expansion on 2026-05-19; Morocco dropped from the exempt lists, e-visa required from 2026-06-07. Sources: Thai MFA lists; Royal Thai Embassy Rabat advisory.

British citizens get a 30-day visa-free stay in Belarus (dataset previously said 10). The waiver is time-limited: valid until 2026-12-31. Note: UK FCDO advises against travel to Belarus on safety grounds. Sources: Timatic GB->BY; UK gov.uk 'Belarus: entry requirements'; Wikipedia 'Visa requirements for British citizens'.

British citizens need a visa for Iran (stamped in the passport before arrival) - NOT visa-free. The 2026-09-04 build mis-scraped this: Wikipedia's 'Visa requirements for British citizens' lists Kish Island (a visa-free Iranian island) as a sub-row reusing the Iran flag, and the parser let that exception overwrite Iran's main 'Visa required' status (parser now fixed: the main row wins). Timatic GB->IR and passport-index both say visa-required. Sources: Wikipedia 'Visa requirements for British citizens' (Iran row + Timatic GB->IR); passportindex.org.

Russian citizens need an Australian visitor visa (subclass 600), applied online via ImmiAccount - not visa-free. Sources: Timatic RU->AU; Australian Department of Home Affairs 'Visitor (subclass 600)'; Wikipedia 'Visa requirements for Russian citizens'.
Russian citizens get up to 90 days visa-free in Costa Rica (dataset previously said 30). Sources: Timatic RU->CR; Wikipedia 'Visa requirements for Russian citizens'.
Russian citizens get up to 183 days visa-free in Peru (dataset previously said 90). Sources: Timatic RU->PE; Wikipedia 'Visa requirements for Russian citizens'.

Argentine citizens need a Vietnam eVisa for 90 days for general entry; the visa-free 30-day option applies to Phu Quoc Island only. Sources: Timatic AR->VN; Vietnam eVisa (evisa.gov.vn); Wikipedia 'Visa requirements for Argentine citizens'.

Argentine citizens: 90-day visa-free stay in Russia (within any 180-day period), but since 2025-06-30 a pre-travel ETA is mandatory - pre-register in the Gosuslugi RuID app and obtain a digital code at least 72 hours before entry. Sources: Timatic AR->RU; gosuslugi.ru; ruID app; Wikipedia 'Visa requirements for Argentine citizens'.

Thailand 60-day visa exemption cut to 30 days for the general and bilateral-30 lists. Royal Gazette Vol. 143 Special Issue 207 Ngor (2026-08-31), effective 2026-09-15; Thailand replaced the 60-day visa exemption with 30/15-day tiers. Wikipedia's arrival tables still show the old scheme — keep these until the scrape agrees on its own.

Thailand moved Mauritius and Seychelles to the new 15-day exemption tier. Royal Gazette Vol. 143 Special Issue 207 Ngor (2026-08-31), effective 2026-09-15; Thailand replaced the 60-day visa exemption with 30/15-day tiers. Wikipedia's arrival tables still show the old scheme — keep these until the scrape agrees on its own.

Thailand cut Visa on Arrival to AZ/BY/RS (15 days); these two were scraped as longer grants. Royal Gazette Vol. 143 Special Issue 207 Ngor (2026-08-31), effective 2026-09-15; Thailand replaced the 60-day visa exemption with 30/15-day tiers. Wikipedia's arrival tables still show the old scheme — keep these until the scrape agrees on its own.

Thailand de-scoped these nationalities from the visa exemption; a visa is now required. Royal Gazette Vol. 143 Special Issue 207 Ngor (2026-08-31), effective 2026-09-15; Thailand replaced the 60-day visa exemption with 30/15-day tiers. Wikipedia's arrival tables still show the old scheme — keep these until the scrape agrees on its own.

Ireland removed Russian and Belarusian citizens from the Short Stay Visa Waiver effective 2025-10-25 (Cabinet decision, gov.ie). Wikipedia still carries the old waiver expiry 2026-10-01 on this corridor — this entry retires that date; the programme itself runs to 2026-12-31 for other nationalities.

Bolivia is a CA-4 associated member (one allowance pool with GT/SV/HN/NI, see the ca4-* stay rules) and the mutual Bolivia/Honduras visa waiver grants 90 days (passport-index; Fragomen advisory). Wikipedia's infobox still says visa-required.
